title: Cart quantities respect available stock
summary: Cap additions and quantity changes at available inventory and disable increases at the limit.

changes.detail: Initial and repeated adds and quantity edits respect selected variant stock; invalid adds are ignored. Explicit preorder behavior is preserved.
Both responsive cart increase buttons disable at the stock limit; product detail shows a maximum-quantity message before success feedback.
